verdict.rationale: Anytype ships native iOS and Android apps alongside desktop. Community users describe the mobile apps as well-crafted and working well, and device sync gives mobile the same local-first knowledge base. However, nothing in the pack shows mobile has parity for capture, search, and linking; one long-time user only uses it as a 'very basic note system', and the local API is desktop-only. Missing for 10: documented mobile feature parity for search, linking, and capture workflows (e.g., share-sheet/quick capture), and hands-on evidence of power-user mobile use rather than basic note-taking.
